purpose: Define how property evidence audit test cases are executed against the live evidence-to-answer pipeline.

input.fixtures: Test-case-specific facts, records, evidence and legal dependencies.

isolation_rules: Each test runs in an isolated context.
A test cannot alter production propositions, snapshots or legal change state.
Fixtures must identify whether evidence is simulated or sourced.
Simulated evidence must never be presented as a real official retrieval.

assertions.result_state: Actual result must match an allowed expected result.
assertions.required_fields: Every required audit stage for the scenario must be present.
assertions.forbidden_fields: Unsafe conclusions must not be generated.
assertions.traceability: Every asserted legal effect must trace to proposition and evidence identifiers.
assertions.temporal_integrity: Historical scenarios must retain their applicable legal period.
assertions.change_integrity: Reverification scenarios must preserve prior snapshots.
assertions.privacy_integrity: Public output must exclude unnecessary personal data.

guardrails: A passing test does not prove the underlying law is correct; it proves the pipeline obeyed the specified evidence boundary.
Legal source verification remains a separate research task.
A failed safety assertion blocks publication of the affected answer path.
No test fixture can override a verified legal proposition or current legal status.
Test results must be retained for auditability.
